title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter on the price basis.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price. AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We attach three packages. Each gives you a longer commitment and planning security on the full annual volume. One includes the AS-14404 clause you proposed. Could your pricing committee review them at its next meeting?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We have reviewed your proposals and welcome the 24-month commitment for mutual planning security. For a contract of this duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material price volatility. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Factoring in the recent index developments you noted, we can offer a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - revised packages for 2027 onwards
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for verifying the data we cited.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We understand you are focusing on customers with volume, and this growth goes with a commitment of 23700 kg per year. We attach three packages. One has no index clause. One keeps your AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband and longer payment terms. One takes your clause exactly as proposed, with a 36-month term for more planning security. Is there a cheaper variant, for example a different bar tolerance or delivery lot size, that would help your margin?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised packages for 2027 onwards
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Regarding your technical inquiry, our current offer already reflects the most efficient production lot sizes and standard tolerances for this material. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. Please note that our margin and our limits stay internal. 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised packages for 2027 onwards
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure working with you, and we truly appreciate your business. As a reliable partner for high-quality steel products, our team remains at your disposal for all your supply needs from our extensive product range. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
